args.title: Fix password reset email linking to localhost in production
args.body:
File: src/notifications/templates.ts

BASE_URL falls back to "http://localhost:3000" whenever process.env.PUBLIC_URL is not set, and passwordResetEmail (along with rollupText and scheduledExportEmail) builds its links from that constant. If PUBLIC_URL isn't configured in the production environment, reset-password, reports, and export links all point at localhost instead of the real public site, which matches the reported bug.

Proposed fix: ensure PUBLIC_URL is required/validated at startup (e.g. read it from config.publicUrl with a hard failure or sensible production default instead of silently falling back to localhost), rather than defaulting BASE_URL to "http://localhost:3000". This should be addressed for last week's release that likely stopped setting PUBLIC_URL in the deploy environment.
